status: CANDIDATE; checks V1-V4 are implemented in work/go-h/validate_targets.py; S1 is a reviewer judgment
purpose: Decide V (derived target is contract-valid) for one target, before any oba call. Target validity is a property of the manifest against source, not of oba's verdict.
unit: one [[target]] record in a manifest, checked against the source tree of one side (base or head) named by the provenance field

fields.module: path relative to the source root; must be a file
fields.test: path relative to the source root; must be a file (oba reads it; a missing test is a read error)
fields.cfg_ident: Nix identifier used to name the configuration under test
fields.option_prefix: walkable root: an attrset path whose last segment is a container, not a leaf option declared with mk*Option
fields.watch: dotted path relative to option_prefix; each intermediate segment is a container, the leaf is an option or container key

side_rule.rule: Each target records side: base, head, or both. Validation runs against the source tree of that side. A removed option is validated against base; an added option against head; a changed-default option is validated against both.
side_rule.reason: Validating a removed option against head yields a false INVALID (observed in the H5/validator run: listenPort_removed flagged on head, valid on base).

checks.name: module exists on the named side
option_prefix last segment is not an option declaration (mk*Option or mk*PackageOption or mkEnableOption)
checks.note: Catches the GO-F pre-correction defect where option_prefix ended in an interior mkOption container.

checks.name: each watch segment is declared in the module on that side: intermediate segments as container keys or dotted keys; leaf as an option declaration or a key
option_prefix last segment is found as a container key at all
checks.note: Reachable only through a helper, so text search cannot confirm it. Reviewer must resolve by reading the helper; AMBIGUOUS does not count as V.

checks.name: semantic remainder: the target's watch paths are the options whose semantics the PR changes, not unrelated siblings
checks.note: Reviewer judgment. Must cite the decisive hunk from the eligibility record. Never decided by oba output.

verdict_aggregation.per_target: VALID iff V1, V2, V3 pass and V4 is not AMBIGUOUS and S1 passes (or S1 is not applicable for a provenance-only check). INVALID if any check fails. AMBIGUOUS otherwise.
verdict_aggregation.per_pr: V(PR) iff at least one target is VALID AND every target is VALID or the PR's extra targets are explicitly marked out-of-scope with a reason. A PR with some INVALID and some VALID targets is PARTIAL_V and is counted in V with the VALID targets only, reported separately. A PR whose targets are all INVALID is not V.

declared_not_checked: Whether oba discovers the option through its own analyzer (that is OBA DISCOVERY, after V)
Whether the test witnesses the option (that is WITNESS, a separate axis W)
Whether the derived target matches the historical verdict (never used as a validity criterion)

validator_evidence.as_recorded_F21_manifests: 5/5 pre-correction option_prefix defects flagged INVALID by V2 (work/go-h/manifests/as-recorded/)
validator_evidence.on_disk_corrected_GOF_targets: all head targets VALID except listenPort_removed, which is VALID on base (side rule)
validator_evidence.known_limitation: 557977 package is declared with mkPackageOption; validator reports VALID; oba reports OptionNotFound. This is a separation between target validity (V) and analyzer discovery, not a validator error.
